github.copilot.chat.codeGeneration.instr.text: Use TypeScript strict mode, prefer interfaces over types
Types: All types and interfaces are in @fin-compass/types, import from there in core/base apps
UI: Never use MUI directly in core app, only @fin-compass/ui components
New components: Create MUI abstraction in ui package first, then use in apps
Icons: Use lucide-react for all icons
Structure: Use /views folder instead of /components in apps
Follow existing: useApiCall hook, Zustand stores, Prisma patterns
API: Routes/Controller/service/validation structure, proper error handling in stores
Import order: React, @fin-compass packages, lucide icons, then relative imports
